# ex: avoid with selector expression (SelectorExpr path)
ex {
	import "fmt"
	var x int
	avoid fmt.Println
	x + 1 -> x + 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

import "fmt"

func F() {
	fmt.Println(1 + 1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 import "fmt"

 func F() {
-	fmt.Println(1 + 1)
+	fmt.Println(1 + 2)
 }
